themes.name: Chime
themes.author: Audex Revival
themes.description: Bright struck-bell tones for every feedback event. C6 clicks and rising two-note cues make buttons, focus changes and charging easy to tell apart without overwhelming speech.

themes.name: Pulse
themes.author: Audex Revival
themes.description: A softer, lower triangle-wave set. Short woody taps for clicks and focus, with gentle falling and rising pairs for gestures, charging and screen changes. Designed to sit under screen-reader speech.
